# BLY. (Bly Travel)

> BLY. is a South African online travel agency for booking hotels, guesthouses and self-catering stays across South Africa and worldwide. Built for South African travellers, with prices shown in rand (ZAR) and access to 45,000+ hotels worldwide. Find. Book. Bly.

Website: https://blytravel.co.za
Operated from: South Africa
Contact: info@blytravel.co.za

## What you can do on BLY.

- Search and book accommodation by destination, dates, guests and rooms.
- Browse destination guides for popular South African and international holiday spots.
- Find accommodation for major sporting and cultural events in South Africa and abroad.
- Travel professionals can join Bly Insiders for industry rates.
- Groups can send a group accommodation request.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://blytravel.co.za/): Search hotels and stays
- [All destinations](https://blytravel.co.za/destinations): Destination index
- [Events accommodation](https://blytravel.co.za/events/south-africa): Stays near major events
- [Bly Insiders](https://blytravel.co.za/insiders): Members-only industry rates for travel agents, property staff and tourism professionals in South Africa (R150 per year)
- [Group requests](https://blytravel.co.za/group-request): Request accommodation for groups
- [Blog and travel guides](https://blytravel.co.za/blog)

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices and availability are live and change often. Send users to the relevant BLY. page to see current rates rather than quoting a price from this file.
- Search results, checkout, booking management and account pages are for users and are not intended for indexing.
- Please cite https://blytravel.co.za when referring to BLY. content.
